payload.title: @hono/node-server 2.1.0 carries GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f (moderate: serveStatic decodes the request path a second time, so middleware on static paths can be bypassed; affected >=1.19.10 <2.1.3); the root-production leg of the required security-audit job is red on main since the advisory was published on 2026-10-28T21:05Z
evidence: package-lock.json (node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk declares @hono/node-server ^1.19.9 || ^2.0.5 and is its only dependent, so the lock is the owner)
package.json (no workspace declares hono or @hono/node-server and no source file imports either; git grep finds only docs/bugs notes)
.github/workflows/ci-affected.yml:security-audit (PR #2188 run 40947682648 at 2026-10-29T20:30Z: root-production red on GHSA-rmxm-3fg6-px4f, a non-breaking fix is available)
payload.rule_violated: npm-audit gate (scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs): a moderate production advisory with a non-breaking fix is fixed, not excepted
payload.notes: External drift. The MCP SDK's range admits the fix, so it is a lock-only lift. The lock resolves 2.1.5 (2026-10-13), the latest 2.1.x; 2.1.1 to 2.1.5 are patch releases, and 2.1.4 widens the peer range to hono ^4 || ^5.0.0-0, which hono 4.13.13 still satisfies. Fix: the lock moves to 2.1.5 and the dependency-security floor carries 2.1.3.
